rollback_rehearsal.action: Set dispatch_enabled false on Operations, retain the runtime-operations journal and execution history, and run recover before enabling dispatch. Recovery only observes. Retain preceding RuntimeRouter local compatibility path.
rollback_rehearsal.evidence: Case C snapshots and restores unresolved journal, recovers applied object, replays without creation, rejects stale attempt and accepts an absent command without dispatch.

remaining_limitations: The new journal service requires an OperationTransport implementing authoritative absence, atomic operation and execution deduplication, and backend generation fencing. No real remote backend exists at G1. The preceding local RuntimeRouter path is unchanged and the new service is exercised by mocked transport fixtures; worker adapter integration is supplied by later runtime packages.

The journal is Redis coordination state, retained by existing swarm snapshots; it is not a durable transcript archive. Dispatch_enabled is an explicit service construction option and must remain false while unresolved operations are reconciled during rollback.

The service stores payload digests rather than prompts. Recovery classifies unresolved operations by observation; an absent operation requires the original request payload for explicit dispatch. Stale conflicts are returned as refused without changing old persisted entries; other entries continue recovery.

When a later package integrates journal dispatch into the ledger server, its runtime folder must join the reload watcher. The trace-plan classifier excluded that integration from this package; proposed on the ledger. Legacy store construction does not load the new journal service.
next_action: Use the qualified operation interface when implementing backend adapters in dependent packages.
mutation_resolution: Canonical codec options and fixed diagnostic messages are module data. Redundant journal key sorting, duplicate nonfinite validation and recovery result clearing were removed. Added digest key order and literal hash, recorded action, nonfinite payload, single connection pool and empty stale result assertions. No mutation clearances used. Malformed observation state and generation types are refused before journal settlement; a string applied state cannot bypass ownership checks.
